page.layout: One page of running text, one column, full width. Faint running head centred at the top and a faint number at the top right. No notes in the margins, no catchword, no signature.
page.notes: The scan is extremely faint and blurred; individual letters cannot be read, so every line is marked illegible and the line counts and word counts are estimates. Paragraph breaks are inferred from the spacing of the lines. The running head and page number at the top could not be read. Small specks and marks scattered over the page are stains or dust, not print, and are left out.
